name: balancer
description: Balances subagent work between Claude models and Codex CLI by quota: off, auto, light, medium, full.

mode.title: Default balance mode
mode.description: off: no routing, the mod only shows quotas and runs Codex when asked. auto: by quota pace. light: Claude first, Codex for bounded code tasks. medium: code split by quota. full: Codex for all code, Claude orchestrates and reviews.

codexModel.title: Default Codex model
codexModel.description: A model slug; empty uses the first model your Codex lists in ~/.codex/models_cache.json.

codexEffort.title: Default Codex reasoning effort
codexEffort.description: low to ultra; not every model supports max or ultra.

stallMinutes.title: Codex stall warning (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Warn when a running Codex job writes nothing for this long. Raise it if your jobs run long silent test suites.

exploreAgent.title: Exploration agent
exploreAgent.description: Subagent type for exploration and data handling, forced onto Haiku; empty leaves the role unset.

codeAgent.title: Code agent
codeAgent.description: Subagent type for code on Claude, refused for code in full mode; empty leaves the role unset.

planAgent.title: Planning agent
planAgent.description: Claude subagent type for plans and design; empty leaves the role unset.

reviewAgent.title: Review agent
reviewAgent.description: Claude subagent type for reviews after Codex jobs; empty asks the orchestrator to review the change itself.

gateAgent.title: Final gate agent
gateAgent.description: Claude subagent type for the final pre-merge gate; empty leaves the role unset.

codexInstructions.title: Extra Codex instructions
codexInstructions.description: An extra line appended to every Codex job prompt; empty adds nothing.
